# Reporting a security vulnerability

Use **Security → Report a vulnerability** in this repository to send a private report. Keep
vulnerability details out of public issues and pull requests.

Include the VIKI Agent version or commit, operating system, steps to reproduce, and expected
impact. Use a synthetic vault or test project for reproduction. Remove tokens, API keys,
credentials, private notes and conversation content from examples, logs and screenshots.

The [security model](../docs/security.md) describes the app's trust boundaries and data handling.

For ordinary bugs, setup questions and feature requests, follow the [support guide](SUPPORT.md).
